items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: The interviewer mentions Sammy Penn ('We got to give Sammy Penn a chance now'), but the interviewee does not respond to this mention, nor does he mention Sammy Penn in any other context within the provided transcript.

ctx.x: I start with Thomas. When Thomas come here. I didn't go get him. He came here to me. And he came here around in 19 and. Around in 15. And that's when you started. Around in the 1915. September storm. Right about a year after that. I can't remember. Because when this cat come through here with that. I had a little brother. And he used to beat on a tube. You know. And this cat here used to be. Thomas. I was. Boy. My brother. He died. You know. And I said. We was going to be some great musicians. I said. We ain't…
We got to give Sammy Penn a chance now. Okay.
Well. No. Sammy Penn. Only chance Sammy Penn got. He was on his own. Because I'm a good boy.
